classification.difficultyReason: Organise repeated integer scores, construct cumulative graphs and identify the middle ordered score.

inlines.text: Draw the frequency and cumulative frequency table.
Count each score, then add the frequencies in ascending score order to obtain the running totals.
Draw the cumulative frequency histogram and polygon.
Join the upper-right corners, starting at the first bar’s left endpoint on the horizontal axis.
Use adjacent unit-width bars centred at the integer scores, with cumulative heights

spec.sourceRegion: Question 19(b); matching teacher graph on PDF page 80, printed page 658.
spec.description: Seven adjacent unshaded cumulative bars with centred integer score labels and a blue polygon joining their upper-right corners.
spec.mathematics: Unit-width bars centred at 31 through 37 have cumulative heights 3,5,7,9,11,13,15. Polygon begins at (30.5,0) and joins (31.5,3) through (37.5,15). Vertical axis cf; horizontal axis X. No grid.
spec.answerVisibility: Complete answer graph appears only with answers.

answer.worked:
There are $15$ scores. The median is the eighth score in ascending order.
$$\begin{align*}\text{Median position}&=\frac{15+1}{2}=8\\\text{Median}&=34\end{align*}$$
The cumulative frequency is $7$ at $33$ and $9$ at $34$, so the eighth score is $34$.
